newsitem.title: FINLAND: MANDATUM HEAD TO STUDY MARKET SUPERVISION - FINMIN.
newsitem.headline: MANDATUM HEAD TO STUDY MARKET SUPERVISION - FINMIN.

text.p: Corporate finance firm Mandatum's managing director Bjorn Wahlroos will study Finland's financial market supervision system and make proposals for changes, the finance ministry said in a statement.

"It is necessary to develop authorities' supervision due to ongoing changes on financial markets," it said, adding that differences between financial services companies are declining, and cross-border integration gives new challenges to watchdogs.
"Credit and insurance institutions' cross-ownership, their similar investment operations and more homogenous services are blurring the division of powers between authorities," it said.
The study will consider the impacts of technology trends and constant market integration on supervision, and changes caused by the third stage of Economic and Monetary Union (EMU), it said.

It did not say whether the aim was to merge the social and health ministry's supervision of insurers with the finance ministry's financial supervision body, which has been a topic of some debate in Finland.
